raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 contains v2-collector rows whose txn_ts is UTC, while the pipeline treats all txn_ts as America/Chicago local time. Those rows are shifted forward 5-6 hours, so evening local transactions from 2026-01-18 get the next UTC date and appear as 00:00-06:00 on 2026-01-19. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago in silver_transactions, before deriving txn_date, fixes the dates, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
